name: Portable Downloads
overview: Temporary mobile downloads with per-item size targets.
description: Alpha for Jellyfin 12.1.0. H.264, HEVC and AV1 with Jellyfin's configured hardware device, temporary scratch storage and automatic expiry. Download-menu integration requires the separate matching web client. EXPERIMENTAL: compile-tested only. Setup: https://github.com/RulerOfNobody/jellyfin-portable-repository

versions.changelog: Initial alpha. Size sliders, codec/track selection, queued encodes, expiring temporary downloads. Inherits Jellyfin transcoding settings. See repository README for setup and client compatibility.
